static_traits.name: Kenton
static_traits.family_status: 与一名考古学家哥哥和一名整骨科DoctorMother共同生活
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships因担心被他人质疑意大利语水平而趋于紧张;日常互动受影响,且难以向家人敞开谈论此担忧
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;without既往心理治疗/咨询史;此前not yet出现类似心理问题

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续担心do not人怀疑我说意大利语的流利程度,尽管我很流利.这种感觉是在几年前搬到新国家,需要经常说意大利语时开始的,我在社交或正式场合都会假设do not人觉得我的语言能力not好,并not断过滤掉正面反馈,专注于他人的负面反应.
basic_info.core_demands: The decisive factor that prompted me to seek counseling this time was realizing that this persistent worry is affecting my self-confidence and my interactions with others. I want to find a way to stop this persistent worry.
growth_experiences: 几年前搬到新国家后,需要经常use意大利语交流.起初在新环境中感到需要证明自己,压力为中等;随着时间推移,在互动中逐渐形成只关注负面线索,忽视正面反馈的模式,每当说意大利语时就假设他人会质疑自己的流利度,导致社交与学业场合的Anxiety与Damaged confidence.

core_beliefs: My worth and ability need to be proven through others' recognition
如果我not能表现得完美,我就not够好/not够流利

special_situations.event: Spoke in Italian during a school project presentation last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在公开场合说意大利语出现任何错误,就会被同学认为not够流利
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在发言前后加倍练习,并在事后向他人寻求肯定以缓解not安
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must think I sound ridiculous, I am making many mistakes

special_situations.event: Speaking Italian with native speakers in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果without法达到母语者的标准,就会被评判和排斥
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 交谈时过度Self-monitoring,说话谨慎,之后反复回想他人反应
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们在挑我每一个毛病,认为我not够流利

special_situations.event: Needs to express oneself in Italian in formal / professional occasions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表现not完美,do not人就会negate我的能力并产生负面后果
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Rehearses repeatedly beforehand and seeks others' approval afterward to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次我一定会出错,他们会觉得我not行

special_situations.event: 搬到新国家后需要经常use意大利语
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在新环境里,如果not能马上证明自己很流利,就会被看低
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps practicing to prove oneself, seeks external validation in interactions

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted (especially to have language ability affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判,被negate,从而失去自信与人际连接
defense_goal: Maintains a sense of safety and control by seeking external validation and doubling practice
In interactions, stays cautious and reduces exposure to avoid being criticized

object_relations.self_representation: A teenage speaker who is scrutinized by others and prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Picky others who may judge at any time (classmates / native speakers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to examine the evidence and challenge assumptions about others' thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets questions as scrutiny of their own ability, tends to believe others (including the counselor/audience) are picking on them (transference: bringing the judgmental other-representation into the current relationship)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use确定性的陈述断言他人的看法,语气谨慎但偏紧张;当被追问证据时弱化具体事实,强调他人的表情与肢体语言作为依据.

manifestations: Relationships with others become strained from worrying about being judged
Finds it hard to open up to family about this worry
Overly depends on external evaluation and validation to confirm one's ability
在公开发言中谨慎Self-monitoring,难以Freedom表达

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: When speaking, repeatedly self-censors and second-guesses her wording and expression
Repeatedly reviews others' reactions afterward to confirm whether one made a mistake
not断寻求他人确认自己的流利度

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 假设他人认为自己not够流利
Interprets neutral facial expressions or body language as negative evaluations of her ability

manifestations: Feels one must prove oneself fluent in the new environment

target_behavior.behavior: 在use意大利语的社交/学业/正式场合出现Significant anxiety与过度Self-monitoring
antecedent: Communicating in Italian in social settings
Speaking Italian in front of native speakers
School projects/public presentations require using Italian
搬到新国家后需经常use意大利语
target_behavior.core_reason: After moving to a new country, there is pressure of 'must prove myself' and fear of being questioned; long-term mental filtering and mind reading lead to high sensitivity to negative evaluations, and self-worth depends on external recognition.
target_behavior.function: Escapes negative evaluation, protects self-esteem and gains external recognition and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence,Interpersonal tension,交流专注度与效率受损,主观疲惫与Anxiety worsened
